# Elegance

Elegance is a light and dark theme whose visual options are exposed through Style Settings, with more than twenty settings covering fonts, colors and spacing without editing CSS. It also configures embedded notes with adjustable heights and smooth scroll, keeps native Ctrl+Scroll zoom, and ships built-in snippets for Dataview cards, MathJax and Kanban. Scrollbars are held consistent, and the improved accessibility is a claim of the recorded description rather than a measurement made here.

![Elegance screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/victologo/elegance-theme/HEAD/assets/Miniatura%20-%20Elegance%20(tema%20para%20Obisidian).jpg)
